title: Documentaries earn the best IMDb ratings; horror films the worst
subtitle: IMDb user rating (1–10) by major genre, films released mostly 1990–2010
source: vega-datasets (movies.json; IMDb and The Numbers data)
note: Genres with more than 330 rated films are evenly subsampled to 330.
description: Six genres compared by the spread of their user ratings, from critically loved documentaries to divisive horror.
author: sofia.g
